actual_scope: Whether any after-cover emitted by the thinned controller, other than 69/20000, makes the selected ordinary formula equal the recorded PR5679 component 3507410738409/1000000000000000.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for one resolved gap on a latest BIT component. The stock-gate reading already compared that component with the pinned ordinary value. This package answers only the cover-field question left open there: read the emitted after-cover before inventing a replacement, and test that finite set in the selected formula. Native, caller, compiler, tape, analytic recovery, and the outer ledger are not rerun.
bottleneck_link: Complex currently binds and BIT is the next cap. The selected ordinary formula is the BIT stock expression inside the selected pricing. A cover the controller does not emit cannot change that ordinary value. Matching ordinary to the component would still not be an admitted-BIT or kappa change: the pricing passes bit_saving = admitted, not ordinary.
stop_rule: Stop after the exhaustive census of the one emitted after-cover. Do not construct a replacement cover, evaluate the odd-prime rule at the algebraic preimage, replay a Gaussian caller, or edit the selected frontier.

open_questions.first_step: Name a second source assignment to after_cover, authenticate those bytes, and only then evaluate the ordinary formula. Do not test the odd-prime rule on a cover the controller does not emit.

open_questions.first_step: Name that caller and the field it reads as bit_saving. Do not infer the caller from this cover census.
open_questions.blocked_by: No such caller is identified or executed here. This package does not take that question.
